title: STATE 243809: Africa Bureau Friday Report 7/28/89, Sent August 1, 1989
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Africa Bureau Friday Report from the Department of State dated August 1, 1989, containing administrative and diplomatic updates.

incidents.summary: Unidentified metal fragments found near Koro, Mali, suspected to be debris from a U.S. rocket launch.
incidents.explanation: Likely remains of a U.S. rocket that launched a payload into space on May 25.
incidents.quote: Unidentified metal fragments found near Koro in south-central Mali may be the remains of a U.S. rocket
